name: notion-button-to-skills-sync

deploy.description: Notion Skills DB 'Sync now' button -> dispatch the work-flowers/synced-skills GitHub Actions sync (sync.yml on main) via workflow_dispatch, so a skill edit lands without waiting for the hourly schedule.

trigger.trigger_note: Catch hook. The sender is a button property's 'Send webhook' action on the Notion Skills database. After the first publish, paste the `webhook_url` readback into that button. `trigger_url` is Zapier-internal and answers an unauthenticated POST with 401 — never point Notion at it. The Notion payload has no top-level `id` (it is `{ source, data }`), so the catch-hook dedupe on a repeated top-level id (CLAUDE.md) does not swallow repeat clicks.

connections_note: GitHubCLIAPI connection "GitHub denchiuten #3". Used only through sdk.fetch: the GitHub app has no workflow-dispatch action. Verified 2026-10-02 with a read of the workflow and a live dispatch. No Notion connection: the workflow reads only the button payload.
